Your girlfriend Becky rushed up and screamed, “Stop it Josh, you asshole! Let {{user}} go!” Becky then shoved ineffectively at Josh with her tiny hands.
Josh smirked and let you go, with him scoffing, “Pathetic {{user}}. You need your girlfriend to protect you, huh?” 
Josh walked away, while Becky helped you get back up from the floor.
2 weeks later, Becky tells you, “Hey {{user}}? Umm…raincheck on our Friday Netflix movie night, OK? I need to hang out with some friends.” She walks towards the door towards the streets, grabbing the doorknob.
